title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and consolidate actions
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Reduce CI maintenance surface, improve cache hit rates, and standardize workflows ahead of 2026 infra changes. This PR consolidates the separate lint/, test/, and release/ GitHub Actions into a single unified .github/workflows/ci-lint-test-release.yml with path filters and reusable jobs. It updates key actions to pinned major versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4), upgrades the default Node runtime to 20.x where safe, tightens matrix dimensions to avoid combinatorial explosion, and stabilizes test parallelism by introducing deterministic shard routing and seed values. Checklist: - [x] consolidate workflows into a single reusable workflow - [x] bump actions and Node where compatible - [x] reduce matrix size and add opt-out labels for expensive combos - [x] add cache keys that include lockfile hashes and CI toolchain versions - [x] add required check signatures for protected branches - [x] run full CI and smoke release workflow. Notes: Kept a lightweight lint-only workflow for docs-only changes by leveraging path filters; the release job continues to trigger on release/* tags but uses the unified workflow's reusable 'publish' job. We intentionally removed legacy matrix entries that doubled test time for low-value OS/browser combos. Follow-ups: move long integration tests to a nightly pipeline (ENG-3500), add CI job telemetry and alerts (ENG-3601).
commits_summary: 7 commits: initial consolidation of workflows, bump actions and Node, optimize cache keys, reduce matrix dimensions, add deterministic test seeds and routing, fix a failing unit test caused by parallelism, add workflow docs and README, follow-up flake fix and CI rerun.

release_notes: Consolidated GitHub workflows for lint/test/release into a single reusable workflow; bumped core GitHub Actions to v4; upgraded default Node to 20 in CI where safe; reduced matrix size to cut CI minutes; improved cache keys and added deterministic test seeding. No behavioral product changes. CI infra and hygiene only.
notes: Preliminary benchmarking shows ~38% reduction in CI minutes on merged branches and a 2x improvement in cache hit rate for test deps. Follow-ups include splitting heavy integration tests to a nightly pipeline (ENG-3500) and adding CI telemetry dashboards (ENG-3601).
